annotations.title: Review a new menu against the baseline

description: Say whether a new menu file should replace the baseline: one verdict (unchanged, safe, breaking-released, breaking, review), what breaks callers, and which findings the new menu adds, clears or makes worse. Use it before overwriting a committed menu.json. Reads the two files only and starts no server.

baseline.description: The menu file to replace, e.g. the committed menu.json.

candidate.description: The new menu file, e.g. new-menu.json from snapshot_menu save_as.

cwd.description: Folder to run from: where the server starts, toolmenu.config.json is read and relative paths resolve. Default: where toolmenu mcp runs.

release.description: The release versions, so breaking changes pass when the bump allows them: "1.4.0..2.0.0".

name: review_baseline
